findings.body: With current Forge on PATH and a client still pinning v1.2.2, `forge sync` never reaches this installation call: src/forge/cli.py:134 checks the pin before loading the handler, and src/forge/repo.py:534–537 exits through the pinned release. That release's sync implementation (tests/fixtures/forge-v1.2.2/src/forge/sync.py:376) has no plugin installation step. Consequently, sync cannot install or update the machine-wide mod from that repo. The previously-adopted test changes its pin first (tests/test_mod_sync.py:163), and the old-session integration invokes sync in the current repo (tests/test_mod_install.py:95), so neither detects this gap. Perform machine-wide plugin maintenance before version delegation while retaining pinned adapter generation, and cover sync with an unchanged older repo pin.
findings.title: Not done: forge sync turns the mod on whatever version a repo pins
